title: Interactive Decision Matrix
description: A polished one-file browser tool for weighing criteria, scoring options, ranking the best choice, and exporting results as CSV.
story: This source run tested whether a fast model could produce a useful, inspection-ready browser utility from a single practical prompt. Gemini Flash generated a self-contained HTML decision matrix with editable options, weighted criteria, automatic totals, a winner indicator, and CSV export.
model_settings: Default Gemini Flash web UI settings visible during the run.
verification_notes: Verified in Chrome from the local HTML file: the page rendered, score edits updated weighted totals and the winner indicator, and Export CSV downloaded decision_matrix.csv.
result_content: Self-contained decision matrix HTML verified locally: rendered successfully, score/weight edits recalculated totals, and CSV export generated a download. Artifact path: public/artifacts/decision-matrix-gemini-flash-oneshot.html.

steps.title: Generate the decision matrix
steps.prompt_exact: Make me a polished one-file browser decision matrix where I can score options, weight criteria, and export the result as CSV.
steps.response_exact:
Your decision matrix tool is ready.

decision_matrix
HTML

This is a clean, dark-themed, single-file HTML app designed for clear visual hierarchy and quick input. Open decision_matrix.html in any browser to score options, adjust metrics, and handle everything locally.

Key Features Included:

Inline Editing: Instantly modify names for criteria or options by clicking directly into their labels.
Smart Computations: Weights (1-5 scale) and scores (0-10 scale) auto-calculate total weighted values instantly as you type.
Visual Anchors: The highest-scoring option highlights with a subtle accent token to pick out the leading path clearly.
Instant Structuring: Dynamically add or strip out individual rows or columns without resetting your work.
Native CSV Generation: Flattens your options, weights, line items, and finalized calculations into a standard schema structure ready for downstream use.
steps.response_summary: Gemini generated a one-file HTML decision matrix with editable labels, weighted scoring, winner highlighting, dynamic rows/columns, and CSV export.
steps.notes: ChatGPT and Claude were also tried with the same prompt but did not complete quickly enough for this seed run; Gemini Flash completed first.
